name: Factory Traceability & Serialization
summary: Complete end-to-end unit tracking, batch coding, and compliance serialization for manufacturing plants across Nepal.
description: Factory Traceability & Serialization empowers manufacturing and bottling plants to mark, monitor, and record every production line output in real time. Designed for FMCG, pharmaceuticals, agro-industries, and beverage manufacturing.
features: Direct Part Marking & Batch Codes
High-resolution inkjet and laser serialization per item and outer carton.
Line-Speed Inspection
Automated optical character recognition (OCR) verifying barcodes at full production speed.
Regulatory Compliance
Full compliance reporting for local standards and global export requirements.
modules: Batch Master Engine
Centralized batch creation, lot numbering, and production line assignment.
Vision Quality Gate
Automated inline cameras flagging misprinted barcodes and ejected rejects.
Aggregation & Palletizing
Links individual item barcodes to master carton and shipping pallet QR codes.

name: Automated Vision & Quality Inspection
summary: Industrial camera systems for automated defect detection, barcode verification, and high-speed package validation.
description: Eliminate manual inspection bottlenecks with AI-powered industrial vision systems. Designed for high-speed filling lines, pharmaceutical packaging, and structural component inspection.
features: Optical Character Verification (OCV)
Validates printed expiry dates, batch numbers, and serials inline.
Surface Defect & Label Check
Detects misaligned labels, damaged packaging, or missing seals.
High-Speed Triggering
Synchronizes camera capture with line speeds up to 1,000 items per minute.
modules: InspectAI Core
Deep-learning vision engine trained on complex defect patterns.
Pneumatic Reject Gate
Automated high-speed air blast or diverated arm for defect ejection.
Audit Trail & Reporting
Stores image snapshots of all rejected items for quality control audits.

name: Industrial Machinery & Fleet Monitoring
summary: Real-time telemetry, engine health diagnostic, and RFID asset tracking for construction, hydro, and heavy industry.
description: Keep heavy equipment operational and secure. Telemetry and rugged RFID tracking monitor runtime, fuel consumption, operating temperature, and location for industrial fleets and remote machinery.
features: Rugged Asset Tagging
Industrial RFID & GPS tracking built to withstand harsh weather, vibration, and dust.
Engine Telemetry & Fuel Diagnostics
Monitors engine hours, battery voltage, temperature spikes, and fuel usage.
Geofencing & Operator Auth
RFID badge login ensures authorized operators run specific heavy machinery.
modules: Fleet Operational Dashboard
Live map and status matrix of all heavy machinery across project sites.
Preventive Maintenance Alerting
Automated service reminders based on actual machine run hours.
Fuel Theft Detection
Alerts dispatch instantly on sudden fuel drop anomalies.

name: Smart Warehouse & Yard Automation
summary: RFID portals, forklift mobility terminals, and automated pallet tracking for modern industrial logistics hubs.
description: Transform warehouse throughput with RFID portal scanning and automated yard management. Eliminate manual inventory counts and speed up truck loading and unloading cycles.
features: RFID Dock Door Portals
Scans entire pallet loads instantly as forklifts pass through warehouse doors.
Forklift Terminal Integration
Mount rugged vehicle computers providing drivers real-time put-away guidance.
Yard & Container Tracking
Locates containers, trailers, and heavy pallets in real-time outdoors.
modules: Portal Scan Engine
Captures hundreds of RFID tags simultaneously without line-of-sight.
Put-Away Optimizer
Directs drivers to exact rack coordinates for efficient storage.
Dispatch Verification
Ensures correct order items are loaded onto dispatch vehicles.
